def git_day():
    """Constructs a version string of the form:

           day[.<commit-number-in-day>][+<branch-name-if-not-master>]

       Master is understood to be always buildable and thus untagged
       versions are treated as patch levels. Branches not master are treated
       as PEP-440 "local version identifiers".
    """
    branch = run_output("git", "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD")
    if branch == "master":
        # Treat master as untagged.
        return "day"
    else:
        # Treat branches as PEP-440 "local version identifiers".
        return "day+%s" % branch

def git_date():
    """Constructs a version string of the form:

           YYYY.MM.DD[.HHMMSS][+<branch-name-if-not-master>]

       Master is understood to be always buildable and thus untagged
       versions are treated as patch levels. Branches not master are treated
       as PEP-440 "local version identifiers".
    """
    branch = run_output("git", "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD")
    if branch == "master":
        # Treat master as untagged.
        return "YYYY.MM.DD"
    else:
        # Treat branches as PEP-440 "local version identifiers".
        return "YYYY.MM.DD+%s" % branch
